d: Bihar men diyara kshetr ke vikas ko lekar siyasat tej hai. vipaksh ke savalon par javab dete hue Vijay Kumar Sinha ne kaha, 'jo diyara dubta tha, ab vo svarg hai.' unhonne diyara kshetr men hue badlav aur vikas ka jikr karte hue vipaksh par nishana sadha. aakhir diyara ki sthiti ko lekar Vijay Sinha ne kya kaha aur vipaksh ko kis andaj men javab diya? dekhie yah bayana.
